f.aa.aa.html: ו Wāw, sixth letter; in modern Heb. = numeral 6; no evidence of this usage in OT times.

f.ab.aa.html:
וְ, וּ,וָ, demonstr.adv. and conj. so, then, and
1 And
2 The ו consecutive
3 With a voluntative (cohort. or juss.) וְ expresses an intention that or so that
4 It often expresses an informal inference, or consequence, so, then, esp. at the beginning of a speech
5 ו introduces the predicate or apodosis

f.ab.ab.html: וְדָן, appar. n.pr.loc., only in Ez 27:19 but identif. wholly dub.

f.ab.ac.html: וָהֵב, appar. n.pr.loc. Nu 21:14, obj. of a vb. now lost out of the text

f.ab.ad.html: [וָו] n.[m.] hook, pin or peg

f.ac.aa.html: וזר (√ of foll.; cf. Ar. Arabic bear a burden, or Arabic be guilty, yet v. Fl in De Pr 21:8).

f.ac.ab.html: וָזָר adj. criminal, guilty Pr 21:8

f.ac.ac.html: וַיְזָתָא n.pr.m. a son of Haman Est 9:9.

f.ac.ae.html: וַנְיָה n.pr.m. one of those with strange wives, Ezr 10:36

f.ac.af.html: וָפְסִי n.pr.m. a man of Naphtali, Nu 13:14

f.ac.ag.html: וַשְׁנִי acc. to MT appar. n.pr.m. son of Samuel, only 1 Ch 6:13

f.ac.ah.html: וַשְׁתִּי n.pr.f. queen of Ahasuerus (Xerxes) king of Persia
